Sportman's Paradise/Timber Investment

730+/- Acre Sportsman’s Paradise & Timber Investment in Bibb County

Discover a great property in the heart of the Eoline community. This sprawling 730 +/- acre tract offers the perfect blend of immediate recreational use and a structured timber investment profile. With extensive frontage on HWY 82, accessibility is unmatched.

Timber Diversity: Features approximately 300+/- acres of 2-year-old planted pines and 200+/- acres of 12+ year-old pine plantation nearing its first thinning, providing a clear path to future revenue.

Water & Terrain: A stunning 7 +/- acre lake serves as the property's centerpiece, complemented by multiple creeks and mature hardwood draws that provide excellent mast for local wildlife.
Turn-Key Hunting: Six to seven established green fields equipped with shooting houses are ready for the upcoming season.
Infrastructure: Miles of well-maintained internal roads provide seamless access across the entire acreage. This is a rare opportunity to own a developing asset in a prime Alabama location.
